reviewContext.userProblem: Session 708 left the PDF inline-rendering, PDF-shortcut and modifier-wheel zoom work uncommitted and only partly reviewed. The stale-picker DOM test ('ignores a stale parent directory rejection after a newer picker workspace opens') fails on both the baseline and the current tree because commit 440d902 serialized handleOpenFiles behind queueFileOpenWork, so a newer picker selection waits behind an older pick whose listDirectory promise is pending.
requiredOutcomes: A newer interactive picker open supersedes a stale in-flight open and still awaits workspace initialization. drainNativeOpenRequests keeps its batch ordering and all native-open tests pass.
mise exec -- env PATH="$(mise where node)/bin:$PATH" bun run test:dom exits 0 with zero failures, including the unmodified stale-picker test.
bun run typecheck, bun run lint:biome and bun run test exit 0.
Vitest proves that Shift+L, Cmd+O, + / -, r, Shift+D, j / k, Enter and q work with a PDF open, and that Alt/Ctrl+wheel zoom works on rendered, image, video and PDF previews.
The debug build succeeds, and target/debug/chilla renders a PDF with no CSP or pdf.js worker errors, or each unobservable part is listed as an explicit gap.
All work is committed locally after an accepted integration review.
nonGoals: No rework or reimplementation of the session-708 PDF work; leaf plans re-verify and repair review-found defects only.
No change to native-open draining order or to queueFileOpenWork semantics for drainNativeOpenRequests.
No weakening or deletion of any existing test.
No repeat of the cc1d40b baseline comparison.
constraints: Keep the uncommitted session-708 work and build on it.
Do not modify unrelated files. Do not touch .riela/ or riela-lock.json.
Node-based gates run as mise exec -- env PATH="$(mise where node)/bin:$PATH" <cmd> and record node v22.23.4.
Run no detached processes. The runtime launch is an owned foreground process with a bounded timeout.
Implementers run no git mutations. Commits happen in workflow finalization, with no AI attribution, no Co-Authored-By and no emojis.
Plan archiving and impl-plans/README.md are handled by the plan-archive node.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: handleOpenFiles stops calling queueFileOpenWork; it awaits workspaceInitialized, checks disposal, then calls openSelectedFiles directly.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: openSelectedFiles already has directoryRequestId ownership checks designed for latest-wins supersession (design-docs/specs/design-macos-file-open.md#interactive-picker-supersession); the strict serial queue defeated them.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: drainNativeOpenRequests remains the only queueFileOpenWork caller.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Native open batches need in-order processing; the picker does not.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Session-708 leaf plans are re-verify-only with review-driven repairs.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: The work is already implemented and partly reviewed; reimplementing risks regressions.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: pdf.js uses a shared PDFWorker({ port }) passed as the worker option.
Runtime launch is an owned foreground process with a timeout instead of nohup/&.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: The runner forbids detached commands; this overrides the workflowInput background-launch hint.

intentionalTradeoffs: Picker and native opens interleave latest-start-wins (design rule 5).
pdfjs-dist 5.7.284 lists @napi-rs/canvas as an optional dependency, adding supply-chain surface.
The PDF error state's 'Open in default app' button is the only focusable element and exists only when a load fails.
supportedEdgeCases: A newer picker selection opens while an older single-file pick's parent listDirectory is still pending; the stale rejection is ignored.
Picker open before workspace initialization waits for workspaceInitialized.
Picker open after disposal is a no-op.
Plain wheel without Alt/Ctrl is not preventDefaulted; zoom clamps hold.
Audio previews register no zoom; video Space/seek behavior is unchanged.
Shared pdf.js worker is reset after an error or construction failure.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Strict ordering between picker opens and concurrent native-open batches.
GUI or inspector evidence that is unobservable from the sandbox; recorded as an explicit gap.
A 'picker waits for initialization' regression test if not reachable; may be logged without production changes.
